summary: {senator} takes an overdue hearing-aid rule back to the agency after a new president takes office.
realLife: On the Senate floor in 2021, Chuck Grassley said he and Elizabeth Warren had pressed both the Trump and Biden administrations to carry out the hearing-aid law.
inGame: needs: implementation deadline, current agency leadership and past correspondence.

turns.pulledBy: The new administration publishes a proposal.
turns.what: The sponsors acknowledge the agency response.
turns.writesBack: Their next inquiry can address the proposal itself.

turns.pulledBy: The incoming team offers no timetable.
turns.what: The sponsors produce the earlier correspondence.
turns.writesBack: The committee can ask when the outstanding request will be answered.
